Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8111); Samaria (i.e. Shomeron), a city and region of Palestine:--Samaria.
BiblicalUsage: Samaria is a city and region of Palestine, home of the Samaritans. You find the name in Acts 1:8, "…shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost…", and again in John 4:4 and Luke 17:11.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Samaria is on the map because God did his work in real places, not in nowhere. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
